author: whilealive
name: whilealive's module presets
description: Module presets from whilealive's darktable-styles-n-presets repository: six color balance RGB looks (two recreating Boris Hajdukovic's settings, one recreating Avid Andrew's starting point, two base-sigmoid variants and a test preset), a magenta-to-green/yellow-to-blue color calibration preset, clarity and fast-sharpen presets for diffuse or sharpen, and a standard lens correction preset.
